original.title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
original.description: A classic Sunday pot roast with carrots and potatoes that cooks itself in the slow cooker until fork-tender.
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb boneless beef chuck roast
1/2 cup dry red wine or more broth
2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water
steps: Pat the roast dry and season it all over with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the roast for 4 to 5 minutes per side until deeply browned.
Arrange the potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker and set the roast on top.
Whisk the broth, wine, tomato paste and Worcestershire in the hot skillet, scraping up the browned bits, and pour it over the roast.
Tuck in the thyme and rosemary, cover, and cook on LOW for 8 to 9 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the beef shreds easily.
Transfer the meat and vegetables to a platter and tent with foil.
Skim the fat from the cooking liquid and pour it into a saucepan, bring to a boil, and whisk in the cornstarch slurry until thickened.
Slice or shred the beef and serve with the vegetables and gravy.

original.title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
original.description: Smoky, spice-rubbed pork shoulder cooked low and slow, shredded and tossed with barbecue sauce for sandwiches.
steps: Mix the brown sugar, paprika, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin and cayenne and rub it all over the pork.
Scatter the onion in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker and set the pork on top.
Pour the vinegar and broth around the pork.
Cover and cook on LOW for 10 to 12 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the pork falls apart easily.
Transfer the pork to a cutting board, discard any fat, and shred it with two forks.
Skim the fat from the liquid in the slow cooker, then return the pork and stir in 1 cup of barbecue sauce and about 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid.
Keep warm on the LOW or WARM setting and serve on buns with coleslaw and the remaining sauce.

original.title: Slow Cooker Beef and Bean Chili
original.description: A thick, hearty beef chili with two kinds of beans that simmers all day for deep flavor.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes with green chiles
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz) pinto beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Brown the ground beef with the onion and bell pepper in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up the meat, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, oregano and paprika and cook 1 minute until fragrant, then drain off excess fat.
Transfer the mixture to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, beans, broth, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours.
Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding a pinch of cayenne for more heat.
Ladle into bowls and top with cheddar, sour cream and green onions.

original.title: Slow Cooker Apple Butter
original.description: Smooth, deeply spiced apple butter made by cooking apples down overnight in the slow cooker — no constant stirring required.
ingredients: 5 lb apples (a mix such as Gala, Fuji and Granny Smith), peeled, cored and sliced
steps: Place the apples in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Mix the sugars, spices and salt, sprinkle over the apples, add the vinegar, and toss to coat.
Cover and cook on LOW for 10 hours, stirring once or twice if you can, until the apples are very dark and soft.
Stir in the vanilla and purée the mixture until smooth with an immersion blender.
Cook uncovered on LOW for 1 to 2 hours more, stirring occasionally, until thick enough to hold its shape on a spoon.
Spoon into clean jars, let cool, and refrigerate for up to 3 weeks or freeze for up to 1 year.
Serve on toast, biscuits or with pork chops (makes about 6 cups; 1 serving is 2 tablespoons).

original.title: Slow Cooker Macaroni and Cheese
original.description: Ultra-creamy mac and cheese that cooks right in the slow cooker with no boiling of the pasta.
ingredients: 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack or Gruyère cheese
steps: Grease the insert of a 6-quart slow cooker with butter or cooking spray.
Add the uncooked macaroni and melted butter and stir to coat.
Stir in the evaporated milk, whole milk, salt, mustard, pepper and paprika.
Add the cream cheese and 3 cups of the shredded cheese and stir well.
Cover and cook on LOW for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, stirring every 30 to 45 minutes, until the pasta is tender (do not cook on HIGH, which can make it grainy).
Stir in the remaining cheese and a splash of milk if the sauce is too thick.
Let sit, covered, for 10 minutes on WARM and serve.

original.title: Slow Cooker White Chicken Chili
original.description: A creamy white chili with chicken, white beans and green chiles that practically makes itself.
ingredients: 2 cans (4 oz each) diced green chiles
3 cans (15 oz each) cannellini or great northern beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Place the chicken in a 6-quart slow cooker and top with the onion, garlic, green chiles and beans.
Sprinkle in the cumin, oregano, chili powder, salt and pepper and pour in the broth.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 to 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the chicken is tender.
Remove the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Mash about 1 cup of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the chili.
Return the chicken and stir in the cream cheese, sour cream and corn.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes more until the cheese melts and the corn is hot.
Serve topped with cilantro, avocado, Monterey Jack and a squeeze of lime.

original.title: Slow Cooker Swedish Meatballs
original.description: Tender homemade meatballs in a rich, creamy beef gravy with a hint of allspice, cooked hands-off in the slow cooker.
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or heavy cream
steps: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes in a large bowl.
Add the beef, pork, onion, egg, salt, pepper, allspice and nutmeg and mix gently until combined.
Roll into 1 1/2-inch meatballs and brown them in batches in a lightly oiled skillet, or bake them at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes.
Whisk the broth, Worcestershire, mustard and flour together until smooth and pour into a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the browned meatballs and gently stir to coat.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or on HIGH for 2 to 3 hours.
Stir in the sour cream and cook on LOW for 15 minutes more until heated through; do not let it boil.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve over egg noodles or mashed potatoes with lingonberry jam.

original.title: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Chicken
original.description: Chicken thighs braised in a sweet and savory honey, soy and garlic sauce, thickened into a sticky glaze.
ingredients: 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp cold water
steps: Arrange the chicken thighs in a single layer in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Whisk together the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic, ginger, vinegar, sesame oil and red pepper flakes and pour over the chicken.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and is tender.
Transfer the chicken to a plate.
Stir the cornstarch slurry into the sauce, cover and cook on HIGH for 15 minutes until thickened.
Return the chicken to the sauce, turning to coat.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions and serve over steamed rice.

original.title: Slow Cooker Split Pea Soup with Ham
original.description: Thick, smoky split pea soup made with a meaty ham bone and vegetables, simmered all day.
ingredients: 1 lb dried green split peas, rinsed
1 meaty ham bone or 2 smoked ham hocks
8 cups low-sodium chicken broth or water
steps: Place the split peas in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, garlic, bay leaves, thyme and pepper.
Nestle the ham bone in the center and add the diced ham.
Pour in the broth, cover, and cook on LOW for 8 to 10 hours or on HIGH for 4 to 5 hours until the peas have broken down.
Remove the ham bone and bay leaves, pull any meat from the bone, chop it and return it to the soup.
Stir vigorously or blend part of the soup for a smoother texture, adding water if it is too thick.
Season with salt to taste (the ham adds plenty) and serve with crusty bread.

original.title: Slow Cooker Pork Carnitas
original.description: Citrus- and cumin-scented pork shoulder slow cooked until meltingly tender, then crisped under the broiler for tacos.
ingredients: 4 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 3-inch chunks
steps: Mix the salt, pepper, cumin, oregano and chili powder and rub it all over the pork.
Place the onion, garlic and jalapeño in a 6-quart slow cooker and set the pork on top.
Pour the orange and lime juice over the pork and add the bay leaves.
Cover and cook on LOW for 9 to 10 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the pork falls apart.
Remove the pork, shred it with two forks, and toss it with about 1/2 cup of the strained cooking juices.
Spread the pork on a large rimmed baking sheet and broil 4 inches from the heat for 4 to 6 minutes until the edges are browned and crisp.
Drizzle with a little more of the juices and serve in warm tortillas with onion, cilantro, lime and salsa verde.

original.title: Slow Cooker Butter Chicken
original.description: A mild, creamy Indian-style tomato curry with tender chicken, rich with butter, garam masala and cream.
ingredients: 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
4 cups cooked basmati rice, for serving
steps: Place the chicken, onion, garlic and ginger in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Stir together the tomato sauce, tomato paste, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, paprika, chili powder and salt and pour over the chicken.
Dot the top with the butter.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours until the chicken is cooked through and tender.
Whisk the cream and yogurt together and stir into the curry.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 15 to 20 minutes more until heated through.
Taste for salt, sprinkle with cilantro, and serve over basmati rice with naan.

original.title: Slow Cooker Hot Cocoa
original.description: Rich, creamy hot chocolate made in the slow cooker and kept warm for a crowd.
ingredients: 1 cup mini marshmallows or whipped cream, for serving
steps: Whisk the cocoa powder with 1 cup of the milk in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker until no lumps remain.
Add the remaining milk, condensed milk, cream, chocolate chips and salt and stir well.
Cover and cook on LOW for 2 hours, whisking every 30 minutes, until the chocolate is melted and the cocoa is hot.
Whisk in the vanilla just before serving.
Switch the slow cooker to WARM to keep the cocoa hot for up to 2 hours, whisking occasionally.
Ladle into mugs and top with marshmallows or whipped cream.

original.title: Slow Cooker Cinnamon Apples
original.description: Tender, buttery cinnamon apples that make a warm side dish or a topping for ice cream, oatmeal or pancakes.
ingredients: 6 large apples (such as Honeycrisp or Gala), peeled, cored and sliced
steps: Toss the apples with the lemon juice in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker.
Mix the sugars, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and cornstarch and sprinkle over the apples, then toss to coat.
Scatter the butter over the top.
Cover and cook on LOW for 3 to 4 hours or on HIGH for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring once halfway, until the apples are tender but not mushy.
Stir in the vanilla.
Serve warm as a side with pork, or spoon over vanilla ice cream, oatmeal or pancakes.

original.title: Slow Cooker Lasagna
original.description: Layers of meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella with uncooked noodles that cook right in the slow cooker.
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or Italian sausage
steps: Brown the beef with the onion in a skillet over medium-high heat, then add the garlic, drain the fat, and stir in the marinara, crushed tomatoes, basil, oregano and salt.
Mix the ricotta, egg, Parmesan and parsley in a bowl.
Grease a 6-quart oval slow cooker and spread 1 cup of meat sauce over the bottom.
Layer 4 noodles on top, breaking them to fit, then spread with one third of the ricotta mixture, one third of the remaining sauce and 1 cup of mozzarella.
Repeat the layers twice more, making sure the top noodles are completely covered with sauce and ending with mozzarella.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours until the noodles are tender (avoid HIGH, which can scorch the edges).
Turn off the slow cooker, remove the lid and let the lasagna rest for 20 to 30 minutes so it firms up before slicing.

original.title: Slow Cooker Jambalaya
original.description: A Creole jambalaya of chicken, andouille sausage, the holy trinity and spices, with shrimp and rice added near the end.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Place the chicken, sausage, onion, bell pepper, celery and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, broth, Creole seasoning, thyme, oregano, bay leaves and cayenne and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 to 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours.
Stir in the shrimp, cover, and cook on HIGH for 15 to 20 minutes until the shrimp are pink and opaque.
Remove the bay leaves and stir in the cooked rice, letting it absorb some of the liquid for 5 minutes.
Taste for seasoning, adding hot sauce if you like.
Serve sprinkled with green onions and parsley.

original.title: Overnight Slow Cooker Steel-Cut Oats
original.description: Creamy steel-cut oatmeal that cooks overnight so breakfast is ready when you wake up.
ingredients: 2 tbsp maple syrup or brown sugar
steps: Generously grease the insert of a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker with butter or cooking spray to prevent sticking.
Add the oats, water, milk, maple syrup, cinnamon, salt, vanilla and apple and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours (overnight), or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours.
Stir well in the morning; add a splash of milk if the oats are too thick.
Spoon into bowls and top with nuts, berries and a drizzle of maple syrup.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 5 days and reheat with a little milk.

original.title: Slow Cooker Breakfast Casserole
original.description: A hearty hash brown, sausage, egg and cheese casserole that cooks overnight for holiday mornings and brunches.
ingredients: 1 bag (30 oz) frozen shredded hash browns, partially thawed
steps: Brown the sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, then drain it on paper towels.
Grease a 6-quart slow cooker well.
Layer one third of the hash browns, then one third each of the sausage, onion, bell pepper and cheese; repeat twice more.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, pepper, dry mustard and garlic powder and pour evenly over the layers.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the eggs are set in the center.
Sprinkle with green onions, cut into squares and serve with salsa or hot sauce.

original.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Noodle Soup
original.description: Comforting homemade chicken noodle soup with tender vegetables and egg noodles, slow cooked from raw chicken.
ingredients: 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs
steps: Place the chicken, onion, carrots, celery and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the broth, bay leaves, thyme, rosemary, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 to 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the chicken is tender.
Remove the chicken and shred it with two forks, then discard the bay leaves.
Stir in the egg noodles, cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken to the pot and stir in the parsley and lemon juice.
Taste for salt and pepper and serve hot.

original.title: Slow Cooker Beef Stroganoff
original.description: Tender strips of beef and mushrooms in a creamy, tangy sauce, served over buttered egg noodles.
ingredients: 2 lb beef chuck roast, cut into thin strips
12 oz egg noodles, cooked and buttered
steps: Toss the beef with the salt, pepper and flour.
Place the onion, mushrooms and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker and add the beef on top.
Whisk the broth, Worcestershire, mustard and paprika and pour over the beef.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 to 5 hours until the beef is tender.
Stir in the cream cheese until melted, then stir in the sour cream.
Cover and cook on LOW for 10 minutes more until heated through.
Serve over hot buttered egg noodles and sprinkle with parsley.

original.title: Slow Cooker Corned Beef and Cabbage
original.description: Spiced corned beef simmered with potatoes, carrots and cabbage for an easy St. Patrick's Day feast.
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb corned beef brisket with spice packet
1 bottle (12 oz) Irish stout or 1 1/2 cups beef broth
1 small head green cabbage, cut into 8 wedges
steps: Rinse the corned beef and pat it dry.
Place the potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker.
Set the corned beef fat side up on the vegetables and sprinkle with the spice packet.
Pour the stout and water over the top.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 to 9 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the beef is fork-tender.
Add the cabbage wedges around the beef, cover and cook on HIGH for 45 minutes to 1 hour until tender.
Transfer the beef to a cutting board, rest 10 minutes, and slice thinly against the grain.
Toss the vegetables with butter and parsley and serve with the beef and grainy mustard.

original.title: Slow Cooker Bolognese Sauce
original.description: A rich, meaty Italian ragù that simmers gently for hours, perfect for pasta or lasagna.
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry red or white wine
1/2 cup whole milk or heavy cream
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 to 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef and pork and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Pour in the wine and simmer for 2 minutes, scraping the pan, then transfer everything to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, bay leaf, oregano, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours.
Remove the bay leaf, stir in the milk and cook uncovered on HIGH for 20 minutes to thicken slightly.
Toss with cooked pasta and serve topped with Parmesan.

original.title: Slow Cooker Mulled Apple Cider
original.description: Fragrant hot apple cider infused with orange, cinnamon and cloves that fills the house with the smell of fall.
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown sugar or maple syrup (optional)
1 cup bourbon or spiced rum (optional, for adults)
steps: Pour the cider into a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the orange slices, cinnamon sticks, cloves, allspice, star anise and ginger (put the small spices in a tea ball or cheesecloth for easy removal).
Stir in the brown sugar if you like it sweeter.
Cover and cook on LOW for 3 to 4 hours or on HIGH for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until hot and fragrant.
Remove the spice bundle and switch to WARM to keep the cider hot for serving.
Ladle into mugs, adding a shot of bourbon or rum to individual cups if desired.

original.title: Slow Cooker Beef Barbacoa
original.description: Mexican-style shredded beef braised with chipotles, garlic, lime and spices until tender, for tacos, burritos and bowls.
ingredients: 3 lb beef chuck roast, cut into 4 pieces
3 chipotle peppers in adobo, plus 2 tbsp adobo sauce
steps: Season the beef all over with salt and pepper and place it in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Blend the onion, garlic, chipotles with adobo sauce, lime juice, vinegar, broth, cumin, oregano and cloves until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the beef and tuck in the bay leaves.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 to 10 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the beef shreds easily.
Remove the bay leaves, shred the beef with two forks right in the slow cooker, and stir it into the juices.
Let it soak in the juices on WARM for 10 minutes, then taste for salt.
Serve in warm tortillas topped with cilantro and onion, or over rice for burrito bowls.

original.title: Slow Cooker Brown Sugar Glazed Ham
original.description: A spiral-cut ham glazed with brown sugar, honey and Dijon, slow cooked to stay moist and free up the oven.
ingredients: 1 fully cooked bone-in spiral-cut ham (7 to 8 lb)
steps: Place the ham cut side down in a 6- or 7-quart oval slow cooker, trimming it if needed so the lid closes.
Stir together the brown sugar, honey, juice, mustard, cinnamon and cloves.
Spread about two thirds of the glaze over the ham and between the slices.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours until heated through to 140°F (60°C).
Brush the ham with the remaining glaze and the juices in the pot halfway through and again at the end.
Transfer to a platter, spoon the pan juices over the slices, and serve.

original.title: Slow Cooker Herb Turkey Breast
original.description: A juicy bone-in turkey breast rubbed with garlic herb butter and cooked in the slow cooker — ideal for small Thanksgiving gatherings.
ingredients: 1 bone-in, skin-on turkey breast (6 to 7 lb), thawed
2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water
steps: Mix the butter, garlic, rosemary, thyme, sage, salt and pepper.
Loosen the skin of the turkey breast and rub half of the herb butter underneath it and the rest over the outside.
Place the onion and celery in a 6- or 7-quart slow cooker, pour in the broth, and set the turkey on top, skin side up.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C).
For crisp skin, transfer the turkey to a baking sheet and broil for 3 to 5 minutes until golden, then rest for 15 minutes.
Strain the cooking juices into a saucepan, bring to a boil, and whisk in the cornstarch slurry to make gravy.
Slice the turkey and serve with the gravy.

original.title: Slow Cooker Garlic Mashed Potatoes
original.description: Creamy garlic mashed potatoes cooked and mashed right in the slow cooker, freeing up the stovetop for holiday meals.
ingredients: 5 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks
1 cup sour cream or heavy cream, warmed
steps: Place the potatoes and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Pour the broth over the potatoes and sprinkle with the salt.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 4 hours or on LOW for 7 to 8 hours until the potatoes are very tender.
Add the butter, sour cream, cream cheese and pepper and mash with a potato masher until smooth.
Add a splash of warm milk if they are too thick and taste for salt.
Keep warm on the WARM setting for up to 2 hours and sprinkle with chives before serving.

original.title: Slow Cooker Party Meatballs
original.description: Sweet and tangy cocktail meatballs in a grape jelly and chili sauce glaze — a guaranteed hit at any party.
ingredients: 2 lb frozen fully cooked meatballs (about 64 small meatballs)
steps: Whisk together the grape jelly, chili sauce, Worcestershire, mustard and red pepper flakes in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the frozen meatballs and stir to coat them evenly in the sauce.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or on HIGH for 2 to 3 hours, stirring once or twice, until the meatballs are hot through.
Switch to the WARM setting for serving.
Serve from the slow cooker with toothpicks.

original.title: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken Dip
original.description: A creamy, spicy hot dip of shredded chicken, cream cheese, ranch and hot sauce, served warm from the slow cooker.
ingredients: 1/2 cup ranch or blue cheese dressing
4 cups tortilla chips, celery sticks or crackers, for serving
steps: Place the chicken, cream cheese, dressing, hot sauce and 1 cup of the cheddar in a 3- to 4-quart slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 2 to 3 hours or on HIGH for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring once or twice, until hot and melted.
Stir well, then sprinkle with the remaining cheddar and the blue cheese.
Cover and cook 10 minutes more until the cheese on top melts.
Garnish with green onions and keep on WARM for serving with chips, celery and crackers.

original.title: Slow Cooker Chocolate Lava Cake
original.description: A gooey chocolate pudding cake that forms its own rich fudge sauce underneath as it cooks in the slow cooker.
ingredients: 2 cups vanilla ice cream, for serving
steps: Grease the insert of a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker.
Whisk the flour, sugar, 1/4 cup cocoa, baking powder and salt in a bowl, then stir in the milk, melted butter and vanilla to make a thick batter.
Fold in the chocolate chips and spread the batter evenly in the slow cooker.
Mix the brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa and sprinkle it evenly over the batter.
Pour the hot water gently over the top; do not stir.
Place a clean kitchen towel under the lid to catch condensation, cover, and cook on HIGH for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until the top is set but the edges are bubbly.
Turn off the slow cooker and let stand for 15 minutes, then scoop into bowls, spooning the sauce from the bottom over the cake, and serve with ice cream.

original.title: Slow Cooker Rice Pudding
original.description: Old-fashioned creamy rice pudding with cinnamon and raisins, cooked gently in the slow cooker.
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice (not instant), rinsed
steps: Grease the insert of a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker with the butter.
Add the rice, milk, evaporated milk, sugar, salt and cinnamon stick and stir well.
Cover and cook on LOW for 3 to 4 hours or on HIGH for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, stirring every hour, until the rice is tender and creamy.
Stir in the raisins and vanilla during the last 30 minutes.
Remove the cinnamon stick; the pudding will thicken as it cools.
Serve warm or chilled, sprinkled with ground cinnamon.

original.title: Slow Cooker Braised Short Ribs
original.description: Meltingly tender beef short ribs braised in red wine with garlic and herbs, finished in a glossy sauce.
ingredients: 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water
steps: Season the short ribs with salt and pepper and brown them in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, in batches, about 8 minutes per batch.
Transfer the ribs to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat, add the onion, carrots and celery to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the wine and simmer for 3 minutes, scraping up the browned bits, then pour over the ribs.
Add the broth, vinegar, thyme, rosemary and bay leaves.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the meat is falling off the bone.
Transfer the ribs to a platter, strain and skim the fat from the liquid, then boil it in a saucepan and whisk in the cornstarch slurry until glossy.
Spoon the sauce over the short ribs and serve with mashed potatoes or polenta.

original.title: Slow Cooker Minestrone
original.description: A hearty Italian vegetable soup with beans, tomatoes and pasta, full of garden vegetables.
ingredients: 1 cup green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 can (15 oz) cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 cup small pasta (ditalini or small shells)
steps: Place the onion, carrots, celery, garlic, zucchini and green beans in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the tomatoes, both beans, broth, Parmesan rind, Italian seasoning, bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the pasta, cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Remove the Parmesan rind and bay leaf and stir in the spinach until wilted.
Serve topped with grated Parmesan and fresh basil.

original.title: Slow Cooker Black-Eyed Peas with Ham
original.description: Southern black-eyed peas simmered with smoked ham and spices, eaten on New Year's Day for good luck.
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas, rinsed and picked over
1 smoked ham hock or 1 1/2 cups diced ham
1 tsp hot sauce, or to taste
4 cups cooked white rice, for serving
steps: Place the black-eyed peas in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the ham hock, onion, bell pepper, celery and garlic.
Pour in the broth and add the bay leaf, thyme, paprika, cayenne and black pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 to 5 hours until the peas are tender.
Remove the ham hock, chop the meat and return it to the pot, discarding the bone and bay leaf.
Season with salt to taste and serve over rice with hot sauce and cornbread.

original.title: Slow Cooker Beef and Broccoli
original.description: Takeout-style beef and broccoli with a savory soy-garlic sauce, made easy in the slow cooker.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb flank steak or chuck, thinly sliced against the grain
3 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp cold water
3 cups cooked white rice, for serving
steps: Place the sliced beef in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker.
Whisk together the broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger and pour over the beef.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours or on HIGH for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until the beef is tender.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and add the broccoli.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes until the sauce thickens and the broccoli is crisp-tender.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

original.title: Slow Cooker Sausage Stuffing
original.description: Savory bread stuffing with sausage, celery, onion and herbs cooked in the slow cooker to save oven space on Thanksgiving.
ingredients: 1 loaf (16 oz) day-old white or French bread, cut into 1-inch cubes and dried
steps: Brown the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, then transfer it to a very large bowl.
Melt the butter in the same skillet and cook the onions and celery for 8 to 10 minutes until soft.
Add the vegetables and butter to the bowl with the sausage, then add the bread cubes, parsley, sage, thyme, salt and pepper and toss well.
Whisk the eggs with 2 cups of broth and pour over the bread, tossing until evenly moistened, adding more broth if it seems dry.
Grease a 6-quart slow cooker and pile the stuffing in loosely.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or on HIGH for 2 hours until hot and set, removing the lid for the last 30 minutes to let the top dry slightly.
Keep warm on the WARM setting until serving.
